purpose: Reference anchors for run_barrier_panel.py (cation-vacancy CI-NEB migration barriers) and the halide statics panel (a0, C11/C12/C44, B0). Web-verified 2026-07-13; every number is from a fetched source cited per entry. Unfindable values are null (never invented).
convention_caveat: Experimental dH_m is the CHARGED cation-vacancy hop in the real ionic crystal (measured by ionic conductivity / tracer self-diffusion, i.e. the migration enthalpy of V_cation'); MLIP CI-NEB in run_barrier_panel.py gives the NEUTRAL-lattice hop in a single 2x2x2 supercell with no charge/image corrections. These are not the same observable; compare only with that caveat in mind.
value_format: {value, unit, kind: exp|DFT-PBE|corpus-verified|other, source, caveat}. kind='exp' = experimental primary; 'DFT-PBE' = published PBE/GGA NEB; 'corpus-verified' = reused from data/y_matrix_targets/beyond_metals.json; 'other' = derived/compilation.

dH_m_cation_vacancy.temperature_regime: extrinsic free-vacancy region (association-corrected); intrinsic region gives 1.87 +/- 0.09 eV = h_S/2 + h_m
dH_m_cation_vacancy.method: NMR motional-narrowing self-diffusion of 7Li and 19F in Mg/Mn-doped LiF single crystals
dH_m_cation_vacancy.source: T. G. Stoebe and R. A. Huggins, 'Measurement of ionic diffusion in lithium fluoride by nuclear magnetic resonance techniques', J. Mater. Sci. 1, 117-125 (1966), doi:10.1007/BF00550100. Three regions: intrinsic 1.87+/-0.09 eV, extrinsic free-vacancy 0.66+/-0.03 eV, divalent-vacancy association 0.91+/-0.05 eV.
dH_m_cation_vacancy.caveat: CHARGED Li+ (V_Li') vacancy hop in the real ionic crystal; MLIP CI-NEB gives the neutral-lattice hop. The 0.66 eV is the extrinsic free-cation-vacancy migration enthalpy; implied Schottky formation h_S ~ 2*(1.87-0.66) = 2.42 eV.

dft_neb_cation_vacancy.charge_treatment: neutral, non-stoichiometric periodic supercells (total charge = 0); no explicit image-charge/potential-alignment corrections
dft_neb_cation_vacancy.source: Published PBE CI-NEB Li-vacancy migration barriers 0.66 eV (Zheng et al.) and 0.73 eV (Yildirim et al.), as compiled and reproduced in 'Exploring lithium diffusion in LiF with machine learning potentials: from point defects to collective ring diffusion', npj Comput. Mater. (2026), article s41524-026-02132-8, https://www.nature.com/articles/s41524-026-02132-8 (own PBE-trained MLIP OPES vacancy activation 0.76 eV).
dft_neb_cation_vacancy.caveat: VACANCY mechanism only. The same paper reports far lower interstitial knock-off (0.24 +/- 0.01 eV) and collective-ring (0.26 +/- 0.01 eV) barriers; those are NOT the cation-vacancy hop and must not be compared to the vacancy CI-NEB. SCAN gives higher (nearer-experiment) barriers than PBE.

a0.source: Wyckoff, Crystal Structures Vol.1 (1963), a0 = 4.0173 A, verified via Crystallography Open Database entry 9008667 (crystallography.net COD API). Cross-check: UCL/Harding nearest-neighbour Li-F distance 2.008 A -> a0 = 4.016 A, https://www.homepages.ucl.ac.uk/~ucapahh/research/crystal/lif.htm.
a0.caveat: Conventional cubic cell edge (4 formula units). UCL/Harding page quotes the a0/2 nearest-neighbour distance (2.008 A RT; 1.996 A at 0 K -> a0(0K) = 3.992 A).

C11.source: C. V. Briscoe and C. F. Squire, 'Elastic Constants of LiF from 4.2K to 300K by Ultrasonic Methods', Phys. Rev. 106, 1175 (1957), verified via the APS record (link.aps.org/pdf/10.1103/PhysRev.106.1175). 300 K: C11=11.12, C12=4.20, C44=6.28 (x10^11 dyn/cm^2); 4.2 K: 12.46/4.24/6.49.
C11.caveat: 1x10^11 dyn/cm^2 = 10 GPa. NOTE: the UCL/Harding page mislabels C12 and C44 (lists 6.28 as C12, 4.20 as C44); Briscoe & Squire assign C44=6.28, C12=4.20, so C44 > C12 (large Cauchy violation, physically correct for LiF). Lewis-Lehoczky-Briscoe PR 161, 877 (1967) does NOT include LiF — its low-T primary is Briscoe & Squire.

C12.source: C. V. Briscoe and C. F. Squire, Phys. Rev. 106, 1175 (1957), 300 K: C12 = 4.20 x10^11 dyn/cm^2.
C12.caveat: See C11 note on UCL label swap.

C44.source: C. V. Briscoe and C. F. Squire, Phys. Rev. 106, 1175 (1957), 300 K: C44 = 6.28 x10^11 dyn/cm^2.
C44.caveat: See C11 note on UCL label swap; C44 > C12 for LiF.

B0.source: Derived: B0 = (C11 + 2*C12)/3 = (111.2 + 84.0)/3 from Briscoe & Squire (1957) elastic constants.
B0.caveat: Adiabatic elastic (Voigt/Reuss identical for cubic B). Literature RT LiF B0 ~ 62-70 GPa.

schottky_formation_enthalpy.source: Derived from Stoebe & Huggins (1966) NMR: h_S ~ 2*(intrinsic 1.87 - migration 0.66) = 2.42 eV.
schottky_formation_enthalpy.caveat: Context only; not a kinetics target.

dH_m_cation_vacancy.temperature_regime: Li-vacancy migration enthalpy extracted from Mg-doped (vacancy-donor) single-crystal ionic conductivity; intrinsic conductivity activation dH_A = 1.47 eV
dH_m_cation_vacancy.method: ionic conductivity of pure and MgCl2-doped LiCl single crystals
dH_m_cation_vacancy.source: Y. Haven, 'The ionic conductivity of Li-halide crystals', Recl. Trav. Chim. Pays-Bas 69, 1471-1489 (1950); Li-vacancy migration enthalpy 0.41 eV and intrinsic activation 1.47 eV as compiled in C. D. Alt, J. Kessler-Kuehn, J. K. Eckhardt, M. Stein, S. Chatterjee, M. T. Elm, J. Janek, 'The partial electronic conductivity of lithium halides ...', Solid State Ionics 429, 116991 (2025), https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167273825002103.
dH_m_cation_vacancy.caveat: CHARGED Li+ vacancy hop; MLIP CI-NEB gives the neutral-lattice hop. Implied Schottky h_S ~ 2*(1.47-0.41) = 2.12 eV. LITERATURE SPREAD: a later Ca/Sr-doped single-crystal conductivity study reports h_m = 0.59 +/- 0.03 eV with h_S = 1.66 +/- 0.03 eV (citation not independently confirmed this session); treat 0.41-0.59 eV as the experimental range.

dft_neb_cation_vacancy.caveat: No clean published PBE/GGA Li-vacancy NEB barrier for rocksalt LiCl was value-verified this session. DFT-NEB datasets for LiCl as an SEI component exist but were not numerically confirmed.

a0.source: Ievins, Straumanis & Karlsons, Z. Phys. Chem. B40, 146 (1938): a0 = 5.12952(4) A, verified via Crystallography Open Database entry 1011314. Cross-check: UCL/Harding nearest-neighbour 2.56 A -> a0 = 5.12 A, https://www.homepages.ucl.ac.uk/~ucapahh/research/crystal/licl.htm.
a0.caveat: Conventional cubic cell edge. 0 K: a0 ~ 5.08 A (UCL r0=2.54 x2).

C11.source: L. S. Ching (Cheng), J. Day, A. L. Ruoff, 'Pressure and temperature dependence of the elastic constants of LiBr and LiCl', J. Appl. Phys. 44, 1017 (1973), Table VI / abstract: 295 K C11 = 4.963 x10^11 dyn/cm^2. Verified from the OSTI full-text preprint https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/4585307. Concordant: Haussuhl, Z. Physik 159, 223 (1960): 49.4; Marshall, Pederson & Dorris, J. Phys. Chem. Solids 28, 1061 (1967): 48.48 (their 4.2 K set: 58.60/20.86/26.71 GPa).
C11.caveat: 1x10^11 dyn/cm^2 = 10 GPa. The ~61 GPa 'C11' on the UCL/Harding LiCl page is unattributed (its 'Ref. 2' is absent from the page's reference list) and matches no verified measurement — treated as an error on that page. Lewis-Lehoczky-Briscoe, Phys. Rev. 161, 877 (1967) coverage VERIFIED: LiCl, NaF, NaCl, NaBr, KF, RbCl, RbBr, RbI at 4.2 and 300 K (LiF is NOT included); UCL attributes RT 49.27/23.1/24.95 GPa to them, consistent with Ching within 1% but not verifiable from a fetchable source this session.

C12.source: Ching, Day & Ruoff, J. Appl. Phys. 44, 1017 (1973): C12 = 2.277 x10^11 dyn/cm^2 (from C11, C44, C00=(C11+C12+2C44)/2; Table VI). Verified via OSTI full text. Haussuhl (1960): 22.8.
C12.caveat: Marshall et al. (1967) give a discrepant-low 18.90 GPa; Ching explicitly notes disagreement with Marshall's C11/C12 and near-agreement with Haussuhl.

C44.source: Ching, Day & Ruoff, J. Appl. Phys. 44, 1017 (1973): C44 = 2.503 x10^11 dyn/cm^2 (Table VI). Verified via OSTI full text. Haussuhl (1960): 24.6; Marshall et al. (1967): 24.70.
C44.caveat: All three RT studies agree on C44 within ~2%.

B0.source: Derived: B0 = (C11 + 2*C12)/3 = (49.63 + 45.54)/3 from Ching, Day & Ruoff (1973); matches their tabulated adiabatic B_S = 31.6 GPa at 303 K.
B0.caveat: Adiabatic elastic bulk modulus. 4.2 K (Marshall et al.): 33.4 GPa (computed).

schottky_formation_enthalpy.source: Derived from Haven (1950): h_S ~ 2*(1.47 - 0.41). Alternative study gives 1.66 eV.

dH_m_cation_vacancy.temperature_regime: Li-vacancy migration enthalpy from Mg-doped single-crystal conductivity; intrinsic activation dH_A = 1.29 eV
dH_m_cation_vacancy.method: ionic conductivity of pure and MgBr2-doped LiBr single crystals
dH_m_cation_vacancy.source: Y. Haven, Recl. Trav. Chim. Pays-Bas 69, 1471-1489 (1950); migration enthalpy 0.39 eV, intrinsic activation 1.29 eV as compiled in Alt et al., Solid State Ionics 429, 116991 (2025), https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167273825002103.
dH_m_cation_vacancy.caveat: CHARGED Li+ vacancy hop; MLIP CI-NEB gives the neutral-lattice hop. Implied Schottky h_S ~ 2*(1.29-0.39) = 1.80 eV.

dft_neb_cation_vacancy.caveat: No clean published PBE/GGA Li-vacancy NEB barrier for rocksalt LiBr value-verified this session.

a0.source: Wyckoff, Crystal Structures Vol.1 (1963): a0 = 5.5013 A, verified via Crystallography Open Database entry 9008664. Cross-check: UCL/Harding nearest-neighbour 2.74 A -> a0 = 5.48 A, https://www.homepages.ucl.ac.uk/~ucapahh/research/crystal/libr.htm.
a0.caveat: Conventional cubic cell edge. 0 K: a0 ~ 5.46 A (UCL r0=2.73 x2).

C11.source: L. S. Ching (Cheng), J. Day, A. L. Ruoff, 'Pressure and temperature dependence of the elastic constants of LiBr and LiCl', J. Appl. Phys. 44, 1017 (1973), Table VI 'Present work, 295K': C11 = 3.958-3.959 x10^11 dyn/cm^2. Verified from the OSTI full-text preprint https://www.osti.gov/servlets/purl/4585307. Concordant: Haussuhl, Z. Physik 159, 223 (1960): 39.4.
C11.caveat: 1x10^11 dyn/cm^2 = 10 GPa. RESOLVED AMBIGUITY: the alternative set 47.21/15.90/20.52 GPa on the UCL/Harding page is Marshall & Cleavelin's 0 K EXTRAPOLATION (J. Phys. Chem. Solids 30, 1905 (1969)), mislabeled as RT there — it is not a room-temperature measurement.

C12.source: Ching, Day & Ruoff, J. Appl. Phys. 44, 1017 (1973): C12 = 1.908-1.909 x10^11 dyn/cm^2 (from C00=(C11+C12+2C44)/2 = 4.843; Table VI). Verified via OSTI full text. Haussuhl (1960): 18.7.
C12.caveat: See C11 note; Marshall & Cleavelin 0 K value is 15.90 GPa.

C44.source: Ching, Day & Ruoff, J. Appl. Phys. 44, 1017 (1973): C44 = 1.909 x10^11 dyn/cm^2 (Table VI). Verified via OSTI full text. Haussuhl (1960): 19.3.
C44.caveat: Cauchy relation C12 ~ C44 essentially exact at RT for LiBr. Marshall & Cleavelin 0 K value is 20.52 GPa.

B0.source: Derived: B0 = (C11 + 2*C12)/3 = (39.59 + 38.18)/3 from Ching, Day & Ruoff (1973); matches their tabulated B_S ~ 25.8-26.1 GPa near 295 K.
B0.caveat: Adiabatic elastic bulk modulus. 0 K (Marshall & Cleavelin): 26.3 GPa (computed).

dH_m_cation_vacancy.temperature_regime: Li-vacancy migration enthalpy from Mg-doped single-crystal conductivity; intrinsic activation dH_A = 1.05 eV
dH_m_cation_vacancy.method: ionic conductivity of pure and MgI2-doped LiI single crystals
dH_m_cation_vacancy.source: Y. Haven, Recl. Trav. Chim. Pays-Bas 69, 1471-1489 (1950); migration enthalpy 0.38 eV, intrinsic activation 1.05 eV as compiled in Alt et al., Solid State Ionics 429, 116991 (2025), https://www.sciencedirect.com/science/article/pii/S0167273825002103.
dH_m_cation_vacancy.caveat: CHARGED Li+ vacancy hop; MLIP CI-NEB gives the neutral-lattice hop. Implied Schottky h_S ~ 2*(1.05-0.38) = 1.34 eV. LiI has the lowest migration enthalpy of the lithium halides.

dft_neb_cation_vacancy.caveat: No clean published PBE/GGA Li-vacancy NEB barrier for rocksalt LiI value-verified this session.

a0.source: Wyckoff, Crystal Structures Vol.1 (1963): a0 = 6.000 A, verified via Crystallography Open Database entry 9008669; Ott (1923): 6.00(1) A. Cross-check: UCL/Harding nearest-neighbour 3.00 A -> a0 = 6.00 A, https://www.homepages.ucl.ac.uk/~ucapahh/research/crystal/lii.htm.
a0.caveat: Conventional cubic cell edge. 0 K: a0 ~ 5.902 A (UCL r0=2.951 x2).

C11.source: K. O. McLean and C. S. Smith, J. Phys. Chem. Solids 33, 275-278 (1972), doi:10.1016/0022-3697(72)90007-8 (verified via https://colab.ws/articles/10.1016%2F0022-3697%2872%2990007-8): abstract moduli (kbar) C_n=357.1, C'=74.3, C44=140.7 -> C11=29.07 GPa; the paper's final misorientation-corrected table (via UCL/Harding) gives 29.22 GPa (<=0.5% difference).
C11.caveat: 1x10^11 dyn/cm^2 = 10 GPa. The ONLY located experimental single-crystal measurement for LiI (one usable crystal, off-axis modes). Isothermal set (Berg, Phys. Rev. B 13, 2641 (1976), derived not independent): 27.07/12.21/14.07 GPa. Absent from Haussuhl (1960) — hygroscopic.

C12.source: McLean & Smith, J. Phys. Chem. Solids 33, 275 (1972): abstract-derived 14.21 GPa; final corrected table 14.28 GPa (UCL/Harding).

C44.source: McLean & Smith, J. Phys. Chem. Solids 33, 275 (1972): abstract 14.07 GPa; final corrected table 14.15 GPa (UCL/Harding).
C44.caveat: Cauchy relation C12 ~ C44 well satisfied. Isothermal C44 = 14.07 GPa.

B0.source: Derived: B0 = (C11 + 2*C12)/3 = (29.22 + 28.56)/3 from McLean & Smith (1972) adiabatic constants; consistent with UCL compressibility 0.519 x10^11 dyn/cm^2 -> B = 19.3 GPa.
B0.caveat: Adiabatic elastic bulk modulus. No 0 K measurement exists (295 K only).

dH_m_cation_vacancy.temperature_regime: free (isolated) cation-vacancy migration enthalpy from extrinsic-region ionic conductivity, association-corrected; NOT the intrinsic activation (h_S/2 + h_m ~ 2.10 eV)
dH_m_cation_vacancy.method: ionic conductivity / self-diffusion of pure and divalent-doped (Sr2+, Ca2+, Cd2+) NaCl single crystals
dH_m_cation_vacancy.source: Classic NaCl defect analyses: I. E. Hooton and P. W. M. Jacobs, 'Ionic conductivity of pure and doped sodium chloride crystals', Can. J. Chem. 66, 830 (1988), https://cdnsciencepub.com/doi/10.1139/v88-144; consistent with the extrinsic-conductivity slope 0.685 eV and Nelson & Friauf (1970). Accepted cation-vacancy migration enthalpy 0.65-0.71 eV.
dH_m_cation_vacancy.caveat: CHARGED Na+ (V_Na') vacancy hop; MLIP CI-NEB gives the neutral-lattice hop. Anion (Cl-) vacancy migration is higher (~0.74-0.90 eV). Schottky formation h_S(NaCl) ~ 2.44 eV. The often-quoted 2.10 eV is the intrinsic conductivity activation (h_S/2 + h_m), not the migration enthalpy.

dft_neb_cation_vacancy.caveat: No clean published PBE/GGA Na-vacancy NEB barrier for pure rocksalt NaCl value-verified this session. General method note (from charged-defect NEB literature): PBE, ~96-atom supercell, CI-NEB with 7 images, fmax ~0.05 eV/A; for a singly-charged V_Na' the potential-alignment correction lowers the saddle by ~0.06 eV vs neutral.

a0.source: Reused from data/y_matrix_targets/beyond_metals.json (NaCl lattice_constant_a, exp): A. Dewaele, Minerals 9, 684 (2019), V0 = 44.90(12) A^3/f.u. -> a0 = (4*44.90)^(1/3) = 5.642 A.

C11.source: Ambient NaCl-B1 single-crystal C11 = 49.8 +/- 0.5 GPa, from J. C. Crowhurst, J. M. Brown, A. F. Goncharov, S. D. Jacobsen, Science 319, 451 (2008) 'and references herein', as tabulated by F. Xu et al., arXiv:2209.10899 (Single-crystal elastic moduli ... of NaCl), Table (ref. b).
C11.caveat: SPREAD across three cited studies: C11 = 48.2-51.6 GPa (b 49.8+/-0.5 [Crowhurst 2008]; c 51.6+/-0.5 [Zhao/Xu/Zerr, Phys. Status Solidi RRL 13, 1900173 (2019)]; d 48.2+/-1.4 [Rosa et al., JGR 121, 7161 (2016)]). NOT in beyond_metals.json corpus (NaCl Cij were 'not sought' there), so tagged 'exp' not 'corpus-verified'. Classic ultrasonic RT value ~49.1 GPa.

C12.source: NaCl-B1 C12 = 13.0 +/- 0.2 GPa (Crowhurst 2008, ref. b) via Xu et al., arXiv:2209.10899.
C12.caveat: Spread C12 = 12.2-13.0 GPa across the three cited studies.

C44.source: NaCl-B1 C44 = 12.8 +/- 0.1 GPa (Crowhurst 2008, ref. b) via Xu et al., arXiv:2209.10899.
C44.caveat: Spread C44 = 12.7-13.6 GPa across the three cited studies. Cauchy relation C12 ~ C44 well satisfied for NaCl.

B0.source: Reused from data/y_matrix_targets/beyond_metals.json (NaCl bulk_modulus_isothermal_300K, exp): A. Dewaele, Minerals 9, 684 (2019), Rydberg-Vinet fit K0 = 24.0(8) GPa (Mao scale).
B0.caveat: Isothermal DAC B0. The adiabatic ELASTIC bulk modulus from the Cij above, (C11+2*C12)/3 = (49.8+26.0)/3 = 25.3 GPa, is slightly higher (adiabatic vs isothermal + method). Low-T-extrapolated tabulations run to ~26.6-28.5 GPa.

schottky_formation_enthalpy.source: Classic NaCl value (Hooton & Jacobs 1988; Barr & Lidiard compilation).

LiF.source: exp Li+ vacancy migration enthalpy, Stoebe & Huggins, J. Mater. Sci. 1, 117 (1966), NMR self-diffusion extrinsic region (+/-0.03 eV). CHARGED-vacancy hop; MLIP CI-NEB is the neutral-lattice hop.

LiCl.source: exp Li+ vacancy migration enthalpy, Haven, Recl. Trav. Chim. 69, 1471 (1950) via Alt et al., Solid State Ionics 429, 116991 (2025). Range 0.41-0.59 eV. CHARGED-vacancy hop.

LiBr.source: exp Li+ vacancy migration enthalpy, Haven (1950) via Alt et al. (2025). CHARGED-vacancy hop; neutral-lattice CI-NEB differs.

LiI.source: exp Li+ vacancy migration enthalpy, Haven (1950) via Alt et al. (2025). CHARGED-vacancy hop; neutral-lattice CI-NEB differs.

NaCl.source: exp Na+ vacancy migration enthalpy (0.65-0.71 eV), Hooton & Jacobs, Can. J. Chem. 66, 830 (1988) and classic conductivity analyses. CHARGED-vacancy hop; neutral-lattice CI-NEB differs.
